actual: ZERO of those six is summed into any Armor Class total on either compute path. All six are explanation-only recognition records. The only dodge-typed terms actually IN an armor_class sum are Dodge's +1 (both paths, via the feat seam) and Brawler's AC Bonus (hardcoded path only, and PF1 applies it even when flat-footed). Subtracting the six would have produced a flat-footed AC lower than PF1 allows.
claimed: pilot_compute.rs carries at least six further dodge-typed AC terms (dwarf Defensive Training, swashbuckler Nimble, Dodging Panache, Dizzying Defense, Trap Sense, Inspire Heroics) that flat-footed AC must subtract
subject: tranche/7-1 flat-footed AC brief
summary: The brief's named inventory of dodge-typed AC terms was an inventory of GROUNDED magnitudes, not of SUMMED ones; trusting it would have over-subtracted.
verified_by: printed both armor_class sums verbatim (sed -n '42790,42806p' src/rules_core/pilot_compute.rs; sed -n '567,572p' src/rules_core/pilot_compute_corpus.rs), then grepped every reference of DWARF_DEFENSIVE_TRAINING_DODGE_BONUS, swashbuckler_nimble_dodge_bonus, swashbuckler_dodging_panache_bonus, SWASHBUCKLER_DIZZYING_DEFENSE_DODGE_BONUS, trap_sense_bonus and BARD_INSPIRE_HEROICS_AC_BONUS -- each appears only in its own const/fn and in ComputationExplanation pushes, never in an armor_class sum
